newsitem.title: USA: Energen prospectus supplement, equity sale.
newsitem.headline: Energen prospectus supplement, equity sale.

text.p: Energen Corporation said on Tuesday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a prospectus supplement to its $250 million shelf registration for the proposed sale of up to 1.725 million shares of its common stock.

The company plans to use the proceeds to repay a portion of short-term debt incurred to fund the acquisition of various oil and natural gas properties by its subsidiary Taurus Exploration Inc during 1996.
Common stock totaling 1.5 million shares will be offered through an underwriting syndicate led by Salomon Brothers Inc and co-managed by Dean Witter Reynolds Inc and A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc.
The underwriters will have a 30-day option to purchase up to 225,000 additional shares to cover any over-allotments of shares.
Currently, there are approximately 11.3 million shares of Energen common stock outstanding. The shares are listed on the New York Stock Exchange.
Energen is a diversified energy holding company. Its two major lines of business are natural gas distribution and oil and gas exploration and production.
